decided.description: Whether the register decides it: more than 20 members or an entity does; otherwise every member's record must say individual.

differs.description: The register decides otherwise than the status recorded: record the new status, and re-check the directors' accounts in debit (C.2 #28).

entities.description: Members whose holder record says entity: any ends exempt status.

exempt.description: When decided: the register keeps the company exempt (at most 20 members, none an entity) [accountant to confirm the Act's exceptions].

recorded.description: The exempt status recorded in force today, from the ACRA business profile (FR-EQ-11); absent when none is recorded.

unknown.description: Members with no holder record recorded: the test cannot tell until each has one.
